rationale: Price is printing at the absolute high of the day with five consecutive up-candles and accelerating volume (13K → 97K on the last bar), suggesting a momentum expansion rather than exhaustion; it has reclaimed both session VWAP ($6.97) and the 9-EMA ($7.08) decisively and is now printing above the prior-day high ($7.16), which shifts the structure bullish. Invalidation is set just below the prior 5-minute consolidation base (~$7.07) where the breakout originated, keeping risk to roughly 1.7 ATRs; a trailing stop is used rather than a fixed target because there is no overhead reference to anchor to given the breakout.
